visualCharacteristics: Infinite horizontal card rail with round prev/next arrow buttons; image cards with title and category, centred scaled active card in scale mode, editorial horizontal cards with slide counter, optional ice/ink bands.
contentPattern: One row per card: cell 1 picture (optional second picture = mobile crop or partner logo) | cell 2 optional date paragraph, heading (h3) with the card link, category paragraph and optional abstract.
usage: Use for a sliding rail of linked content cards (insights, news, case studies) with arrows and optional autoplay.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any card slider by adding one row per card and choosing simple, scale or horizontal plus a band variant.
